I’d say it’s been building since I retired from the school office… a little over two years ago now.\n\nDoctor: Over these past two years, have you also been feeling sad, down, or empty most days, or is it mainly that you lack the energy or motivation to do things?\n\nPatient: It’s mainly the lack of push, I’d say. I don’t think I’m getting mixed up on the steps so much.
